topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can't stop smiling since I found out. My partner's been weaving our life, our little everyday bits, into a novel. It's a story that only we know, the small moments that mean the world. To see those pieces of us, our conversations, our dreams, turned into characters and plots—it’s like seeing a mirror of our life but through their eyes. It’s more than just a story; it’s a deep dive into how they see us, how they feel. It’s incredible, really, how much care and thought they’ve put into it. Each page is a gift, a new way to understand each other, a bridge made of words and feelings.
